title: Next Greater Numerically Balanced Number
goal: Find the smallest integer greater than n whose digit frequencies equal the digit values.
strategy: Choose which nonzero digits occur; selected digit d must appear exactly d times. Enumerate unique permutations for feasible lengths in increasing length order and retain the smallest value above n.
